summary:
Submitted a research product that folds the second confirmed result and one explained protection back into the implementation map.

Context from the index: both direct-check findings are now confirmed_in_scope (oblig-config-from-durable-entry via check 96a2fe47… and oblig-config-readout-index via check 458dbca4…), map v3 is the accepted basis, pending_work is empty, and capacity still holds 2 audit units, 4 semantic reviews and 6 experiments.

Product contents (draft-relative submission.json plus the updated map.json and one newly acquired source range):

Map handoff, two clarifications with explicit preserves statements and no challenges. First, b-config-readout now records that the synchronous GetConfiguration readout reports the never-assigned zero index and that Raft.Stats publishes the same value as latest_configuration_index, so only the external-consumer question remains open. Second, b-commit-quorum replaces its suspicion with the sourced conditional relationship: the configuration-change gate (raft.go 653-663, newly acquired as SR-CONFIG-GATE) admits a new change only while latestIndex equals committedIndex, and nextConfiguration applies a single server change, so at most one uncommitted single-server change is in flight and any majority of the new voter set intersects every majority of the committed voter set. Its residual unknown is narrowed rather than removed, because that answer is a reading argument rather than an execution.

The accompanying feedback (ref_ids b-config-readout, b-commit-quorum) states both answered propositions, keeps the reading-derived protection honestly flagged, and carries forward the remaining frontier: the phantom-configuration consequence, the other setLatestConfiguration callers, the pre-vote and TimeoutNow premises, and the high-consequence heartbeat fast path surface.

Preflight `validate` returned valid=true with no diagnostics. Acceptance and version assignment remain with the controller.
